verdict.rationale: Adyen documents agent-usable surfaces: an official MCP server for natural-language access to the platform, an llms.txt, and APIs covering balance accounts, payouts, reporting and chargeback defense-document uploads. There is no evidence that the MCP server exposes balance, payout or dispute tools, or that an agent can read balances, trace a missing payout or draft dispute evidence. Missing for 10: documented MCP or API tools for reading balances and payout status, a payout-investigation workflow, agent-oriented dispute-evidence drafting or submission via MCP, a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can work the money side — read balances and payouts, investigate a seller's missing payout, draft dispute evidence — against documented, agent-usable surfaces

citations.quote: This allows developers to use natural language to connect with Adyen's platform more easily and build new payment solutions faster.
